title: Beetle King Ascends 7th Cycle
description: A dark surreal scene depicts a towering beetle king with multiple arms, glowing rings, and a staff standing atop a mound of earth and decaying bodies. Hooded worshippers kneel at the base offering green liquid while scarab beetles and glowing orbs float in the black background.
prompt: A towering multi-armed beetle king with a skull-like head, horns, and glowing golden rings on his fingers and horns stands atop a massive mound of dark earth covered in bodies and scarabs. He holds a staff with a spiral top while hooded cultists kneel at the base offering glowing green liquid from bowls. Swarms of scarab beetles and floating yellow orbs fill the black background in a dark occult ritual scene, high contrast black and white with selective yellow and green accents, intricate linework, surreal dark fantasy style
